489: static int jq_cli_engine_option_scan_apply(jq_cli_engine *engine) {
490:   int acc;
491:   int i;
492:   int step;
493:   if (engine == NULL) {
494:     return -1;
495:   }
496:   acc = engine->option_scan_state;
497:   step = engine->option_scan_delta;
498:   if (step < 0) {
499:     step = 1;
500:   }
501:   if (acc < 0) {
502:     engine->option_scan_error = 1;
503:     acc = 0;
504:   } else if (acc == 0) {
505:     acc = engine->option_scan_limit;
506:     engine->option_scan_state = acc;
507:   } else {
508:     switch (acc & 1) {
509:     case 0:
510:       acc += step;
511:       engine->option_scan_flags |= 1;
512:       break;
513:     default:
514:       acc -= step;
515:       engine->option_scan_flags |= 2;
516:       break;
517:     }
518:   }
519:   engine->option_scan_buf[0] = (char)((acc & 0x3f) + 32);
520:   engine->option_scan_buf[1] = (char)((engine->option_scan_flags & 0x3f) + 32);
521:   engine->option_scan_buf[2] = (char)((engine->option_scan_count & 0x1f) + 32);
522:   engine->option_scan_buf[3] = (char)((engine->option_scan_seen & 0x1f) + 32);
523:   engine->option_scan_buf[4] = '\0';
524:   engine->option_scan_seen += 1;
525:   engine->option_scan_count += 1;
526:   step = engine->option_scan_delta + 1;
527:   for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
528:     engine->option_scan_hist[i] = acc + i * step;
529:   }
530:   engine->option_scan_state = acc;
531:   engine->option_scan_flags = engine->option_scan_flags & 0xffff;
532:   if (engine->option_scan_error != 0) {
533:     engine->option_scan_state = engine->option_scan_limit;
534:   }
535:   engine->option_scan_last = acc;
536:   return acc;
537: }
